name: MCARD_MODE_LOAD
meaning: start-of-game screen: load a slot, or create a new game (0x4d4a66 message 1 outside levels -3/-4)

name: MCARD_MODE_SAVE
meaning: manual save (0x4d4a66 message 1 when currentLevel is -3 or -4)

name: MCARD_MODE_AUTOSAVE
meaning: autosave (MCardManager on message 0x3500 when Progress runtimeBits saveSlotValid and autoSaveOn are set)
